import json, subprocess, statistics, hashlib, datetime
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/tmp/photonic-report')
source=json.load(open('/tmp/photonic-runtime/final-measurement.json'))
case=[x for x in source if x['round']==0]
record=[]
for iteration in range(3):
 for fixture in case:
  argument=fixture['argument'].copy()
  count=3 if fixture['name']=='export' else 21 if fixture['binary']=='expression' else 51 if fixture['name']=='wide' or fixture['binary']=='scope' else 101
  argument[argument.index('--sample')+1]=str(count)
  row={'name':fixture['name'],'binary':fixture['binary'],'argument':argument,'round':iteration}
  for version in (['before','after'] if iteration%2==0 else ['after','before']):
   print('running',iteration,fixture['name'],version,flush=True)
   result=subprocess.run([str(root/version/fixture['binary']),*argument],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
   row[version]=json.loads(result.stdout)
  record.append(row)
  (root/'acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
  def median(version):
   sample=row[version]['measurement']
   return statistics.median(x['execution'] if isinstance(x['execution'],float) else x['execution']['duration'] for x in sample)*1000
  a,b=median('before'),median('after')
  print(iteration,fixture['name'],round(a,4),round(b,4),round(b/a,3),flush=True)
allocation=[]
for fixture in [x for x in case if x['name'] in ['ordinary','scope','consumption','wide','export']]:
 row={'name':fixture['name'],'argument':fixture['argument'].copy()}
 row['argument'][row['argument'].index('--sample')+1]='2'
 for version in ['before','after']:
  print('allocation',fixture['name'],version,flush=True)
  row[version]=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(root/version/'allocation'),*row['argument']],text=True))
 allocation.append(row)
 (root/'allocation.json').write_text(json.dumps(allocation,indent=2))

root=Path('/tmp/photonic-report')

for case in json.loads(Path('/tmp/photonic-runtime/equivalence.json').read_text()):
 name=case['case']
 configuration=json.loads((base/(name+'.check.case.case.json')).read_text())
 source=base/(name+'.check.case.json')
 program=json.loads(source.read_text())
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='photonic-report-') as temporary:
  target=Path(temporary)/'target.wave';target.write_text(configuration['targets'][0])
  value=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(root/'after'/'photonic'),'lower',str(target)]))
  if configuration['preserve']:value['rule'].extend(program['rule'])
  target=Path(temporary)/'target.json';target.write_text(json.dumps(value))
  argument=['prism',str(source),'--target',str(target),'--path','--json','--compact']
  for field,option in [('step','steps'),('record','records'),('state','states'),('cell','cells'),('frame','frames'),('coherence','coherences')]:
   argument.extend(['--'+option,str(configuration[field])])
  report={}
  for version in ['before','after']:
   report[version]=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(root/version/'photonic'),*argument]))
  assert report['before']==report['after'],name
  row={'case':name,'configuration':configuration,'argument':argument,'equal':True,'work':report['after']['work'],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(report['after'],sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()}
  record.append(row);(root/'equivalence.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
  print(name,'equal',flush=True)
